bestBets.overview: At the time of writing (Thursday) the track is rated a soft 5 but with fine weather forecast an upgrade is anticipated. The well travelled FARNANHEIT has been game in defeat at his past two fresh runs and will be fitter for a recent quiet trial. Respect any positive market moves. BOOM BUNNY has placed at five of eight runs this time in and should be playing a role in the finish again. MOONYA LAD has his share of ability and draws kindly. SENSEI GIRL dropped right out at Mackay but had looked close to breaking through prior.

raceTips.comment: Massive day of racing at Townsville on Saturday with the running of the Cup & Cleveland Bay, it doesn't get any bigger in the area. Expect a perfect surface & day plus a big crowd in attendance, the field sizes are large also which will create plenty of value for punters. We open with a 1000m maiden where I'm leaning to Boom Bunny who has placed 5 of 10 & can make full use of the gate, comprehensively beaten last start however did account for the remainder comfortably. Karmardo & Jungle Wonder have the form however not the gates, both will need luck.
